 Park Min Young leads office romance 'Nine to Six'
 Kristofer Purnell - Philstar.com October 21, 2026 | 11:31am 
 Park Min-young during a script reading for "Nine to Six." Prime Video 
 MANILA, Philippines — Office dynamics are thrown for a whirl in upcoming Korean drama "Nine to Six" starring Park Min-young, Go Soo, and boy band Btob member Sungjae.
 Min-young plays a company's legal team senior manager named Kang Yi-ji, who entered the legal profession upon her mother's urging despite an interest in astronomy.
 Yi-ji does not see the importance in love and marriage, that is until Sungae's Han Sun-woo — an intern who'd rather be a jewelry designer — shields her from danger, making Yi-ji rethink her approach.
 Go Soo plays Park Hyun-tae, an executive director at the Seoul office where Yi-ji and Sun-woo work having returned from the company's European headquarters.
 Hyun-tae also sees romance as hindrance though Yi-ji's competence at work has him questioning himself as well. This marks Go Soo's return to the romance genre in over a decade since 2014's "The Royal Tailor."
 Related:  Lovelyz member Jeong Yein replaces Ha Young in ‘The Trauma Code’ 
 "Strong Girl Bong-soon" director Lee Hyung-min helms the project alongside Oh Song-hee on a script by Choi Ji-oh.
 Min-young rose to fame on "Sungkyunkwan Scandal" and is best known for "What's Wrong with Secretary Kim", "Healer", "Forecasting Love and Weather", "City Hunter", "Marry My Husband", and most recently "Siren's Kiss."
 Outside of Btob and his solo music career, Sungjae has starred in "Reply 1994" and "Guardian: The Lonely and Great God", the latter also known as "Goblin."
 Go Soo's credit include "Missing: The Other Side", "Parole Examiner Lee", "Heart Surgerons" and "The Fortress."
 "Nine to Six", based on the Chinese show "The Rational Life", premieres globally via Prime Video on November 25.
